Based on what I found on the Halton Region and Links2Care sites, here are real free drop-in options for a toddler in Halton Hills:

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Kids & Me drop-in program, Halton Hills Public Library (Acton Branch)",
      "age_fit": "families with babies or children up to 6 years of age",
      "when": "Thursdays from 10:30 a.m. to 12 p.m.",
      "price": "free",
      "source_name": "Halton Region"
    },
    {
      "name": "EarlyON Child and Family Centre, Acton and Georgetown locations",
      "age_fit": "children aged 0-6 years",
      "source_name": "Links2Care"
    }
  ]
}
```

Notes on what backs these up:

- **Kids & Me** — 
Kids & Me is a free weekly 1.5-hour parenting and early learning drop-in program for families with babies or children up to 6 years of age.
 
Registration is not required.
 The Acton library session runs 
Halton Hills Public Library – Acton Branch Thursdays from 10:30 a.m. to 12 p.m.


- **EarlyON Centres (Acton & Georgetown)** — 
FREE programs, activities, and resources for children (from birth to their 6th birthday) and their parents or caregivers, offered in Halton Hills
, run out of locations including 
Acton EarlyON Centre (Band Hall), Acton Community Hub (MSB Public School), Acton Halton Hills Public Library, and Georgetown EarlyON Centre
. Links2Care's own page points people to a separate current schedule for exact days/times, which I wasn't able to pull specific hours from — worth a quick call to confirm the drop-in times before heading over.
